fixed.explanation: In innerAsLocators, name and description share one exact flag. A regex is parsed as caseSensitive=true, so next to a non-exact string it counts as a conflict and throws, which falls back to the raw selector. Exactness only matters for string values. The fix checks conflicts only between string values. A regex sets exact only when no string has set it.

input.intent: Converting an internal role selector (role=button[name=... ][description=...]) back into a readable getByRole locator call; a check that name and description have matching exact flag treats a regex (case sensitive) and a non-exact string as conflicting, so it falls back to the raw selector.
input.symptom: Locator with getByRole name and description where one is a regex and the other a string prints as raw internal selector instead of getByRole call.

history.analysis: The conflict check is in the locator generator that converts internal:role selectors back to locator calls (likely locatorGenerators.ts). Searching for exactness handling.
